ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of childcare fraud cases to identify patterns and connections between entities
questions: What are the most common methods used to commit childcare fraud?
How can financial regulations be improved to prevent childcare fraud?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of childcare fraud cases, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that can inform future investigations and prevention strategies.
